t.zh: 工作台读得出一个像素的三个数，却没有问过这三个数各是哪种颜色。一张用<wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref>读进来的照片在这里显示出来，蓝天成了橙色。这一关的问题是：同一张照片，为什么在这里显示出橙色的天空？
t.en: The workbench can read a pixel's three numbers but has never asked which colour each one is. A photo read in with <wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref> is displayed here, and its blue sky has turned orange. This level asks: why does the same photo show an orange sky here?

t.zh: 这一关要接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。把一个像素的三个数拆开、重排，要用新元件：<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出每个像素第 0、1 或 2 个位置上的数（在元件上设定），组成一张灰度图；<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图依次当作 R、G、B，合成一张彩色图。每个像素都和期望相符才算对。
t.en: This level wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. Taking a pixel's three numbers apart and reordering them needs new parts: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes the number at position 0, 1 or 2 of every pixel, as set on the part, as a grey image; <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> takes three grey images as R, G and B, in that order, and makes one colour image. It is right when every pixel matches the expected one.

after.zh: 各个库的<wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>不同：<wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref>读图得到 BGR，<wiki-ref to="matplotlib"></wiki-ref>按 RGB 显示。
after.en: Libraries differ in <wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>: <wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref> reads images as BGR, <wiki-ref to="matplotlib"></wiki-ref> displays RGB.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?
